name: Győrtelek (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Győrtelek (a blue shield with a white horseman, with a helm, a crest and blue and grey mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed GYŐRTELEK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Győrtelek arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
